Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for Soul of Meal, a Vietnamese culinary fantasy anime RPG. Create a high-detail 2048 x 2048 square RGBA image with a genuinely transparent background. Exactly FOUR rows and SEVEN equal-width columns (28 separate full-body sprites). No text, no labels, no panels, no scenery, no ground shadows. Leave a clear transparent gutter between every sprite. Every row contains ONE consistent character with identical face, costume and proportions across all seven columns. Three-quarter view facing slightly right, cute premium 3D anime RPG chibi, smooth sculpted forms, sharp silhouettes, detailed fabrics, expressive faces, Vietnamese-inspired clothing, not pixel art.
ROWS from top to bottom:
1 Nhiên: young Vietnamese male chef, spiky dark auburn hair, crimson áo giao lĩnh, dark charcoal apron, brass wok and flame fan, energetic.
2 Hải: tall slim Vietnamese male water mage, long dark blue hair tied back, indigo áo dài, pale blue sash, round copper ladle and translucent water ribbon, calm.
3 Mộc: young Vietnamese woman herbalist, braided black hair, emerald áo tứ thân, cream yếm and basket of herbs, green leaf staff, gentle.
4 Bách: broad stout middle-aged Vietnamese male guardian, short brown beard, mustard/brown áo giao lĩnh, woven rattan round shield and wooden spoon mace, protective.
COLUMNS left to right: 1 neutral standing idle, 2 walking left leg forward, 3 walking right leg forward, 4 clear forward strike/cast wind-up, 5 strong released magical skill with restrained elemental arc, 6 cheerful victory with raised arms, 7 knocked down on their side. Feet for the first six columns must share the same baseline within each row; fallen sprite lower on that same baseline. Consistent orthographic camera, character body scale and lighting across all cells. Keep effects tightly inside their own cell. No clipping of head, weapon, limbs or garments. Saturated readable colors and real clean alpha edges, no colored matte fringe.
